svg.text: Sticker on the rest panel, 400 × 102 mm
Mark reads as two surfaces at two heights, not furniture clip-art
At 1.2 m the wordmark holds; the supporting line is the first thing to go
Sticker sits on the panel face, never wrapping the tube radius
Minimum sticker 180 × 46 mm — below that, drop the line and keep mark + name
